name: Kugutsu Nakoto
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c15016]Haruka[/url]'s youngest daughter and [url=https://vndb.org/c15017]Souchi[/url]'s niece.  From a young age, she despised Souchi because she noticed that her mother loved him instead of her father. Despite being a girl, she is the living image of her father.  

[spoiler] Her greatest ambition is to rebuild her father's business, for this she has offered her body to her uncle in exchange for teaching her how to run a company, despite this she has been rejected on many occasions. [/spoiler]
